1.consolidated_definition: Tener una mujer diversos amoríos. En España, cabra es la mujer coqueta, enamoradiza. Recuérdese el epigrama de Gabriel del Coral: “A su mujer, ofendido, —cabra un marido llamó, —y ella se desagravió —con llamarle su marido.”
1.en_consolidated_definition: To have a woman with multiple romantic interests or affairs. In Spain, cabra refers to a flirtatious or amorous woman. Note the epigram by Gabriel del Coral: "A woman who offended him, he called his wife a cabra; and she retaliated by calling him her husband."
